svg.title: Initiator's chance to win a linked battle (Ver.1)
svg.desc: P(win) = (16 - threshold) / 16, threshold computed by executing 0x0D7A, equal enhancement.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Who wins a linked battle: the initiator's odds

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chance the initiating unit wins, equal enhancement. Each cell = 16 − threshold, out of 16.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Computed by running the outcome routine (0x0D7A) on the emulated CPU for every pairing; identical in Ver.2.
